verdict.rationale: Bevy's primary language is Rust itself (not a separate scripting language), and evidence shows the ECS is built on normal Rust structs/traits that fully expose engine internals (bevy-docs-20, bevy-docs-14), with community praise for the API's ergonomics (bevy-comm-3, bevy-comm-4). However there is no evidence in the pack of any dedicated debugger tooling or debugging workflow for Bevy, and community notes actually flag friction (verbose UI code, limited docs) rather than confirming a smooth debugging story. Missing for 10: explicit debugger/inspector integration evidence, first-party debugging guide, and independent confirmation of debugging workflow productivity.
